From a value creation strategy – CCAP’s value creation
levers are mainly centred around unlocking the true
earnings potential of our underlying investee companies
and in line with maximising shareholder value.
This is achieved through working closely with
management teams to define and drive business strategy,
supporting business development and fundraising efforts
by leveraging Centum’s networks and subsidiaries, utilizing
synergies between portfolio companies and forging
strategic partnerships both at operational and shareholder
level.
